description.value: Vera's Burger Shack is a BC-based burger chain that hand-presses every patty using 100% fresh Canadian beef and prepares all food to order. The Commercial Drive location puts cyclists in one of Vancouver's most vibrant and walkable neighbourhoods. The chain runs rotating daily specials alongside a full burger and sides lineup, making it a reliable calorie stop mid-ride.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 23m; stands (2 spaces) at 23m. Total: 4 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Vera's Burger Shack is an active, operating burger chain with made-to-order food and online ordering, supporting takeout. Two contact discrepancies exist: OSM lists the phone as 604-254-8372 while the website header and contact section both show 604-683-8372; OSM lists the address as 1438 Commercial Drive while the website contact section shows Suite 516-525 West 8th Ave, V5Z 1C6 (likely the corporate head office for this multi-location franchise). No cycling-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere on the website.
concerns: Phone mismatch: OSM lists 604-254-8372 but the website header and contact section both show 604-683-8372. The OSM number may be stale or incorrect.

Address mismatch: OSM lists 1438 Commercial Drive but the website contact section shows Suite 516-525 West 8th Ave, Vancouver, BC V5Z 1C6, which appears to be the corporate head office. The specific branch address could not be confirmed from the website alone.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, actively operating fast-food burger chain on Commercial Drive; website is live with full menu and ordering. A reliable calorie stop for touring cyclists.
enrichment_extras.notes: This is a multi-location franchise; the website address reflects corporate HQ. The Store Locations page (not fetched) would be needed to confirm the Commercial Drive branch details and its specific phone number.
